title: IAOMS What Do You Know Wendesday
html:
IAOMS NextGen What Do You Know? Wednesday quizzes are designed to reinforce key clinical concepts through real scenarios and evidence-based content. Each quiz is mapped to trusted IAOMS resources, including IJOMS articles and digital learning, helping you quickly identify strengths and uncover opportunities to go deeper.

When you achieve a passing score and enter your email at the end, you will receive a certificate of completion to download and share.

Take the Quiz
